entities.name: Konda's Banner
entities.description: A legendary banner used by Daimyo Takeshi Konda on Kamigawa, symbolizing his rule and empowering his allies.

entities.name: Takeshi Konda
entities.description: A Daimyo and one of the greatest human rulers of Kamigawa who used the banner.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War in which Konda was defeated.

events.summary: Konda's Banner was likely destroyed after Konda's defeat in the Kami War.
events.quote: It was likely destroyed after his defeat in the Kami War

relations.note: Used the banner as symbol of his rule
relations.quote: Konda's Banner is a famous banner used by Daimyo Takeshi Konda
